Method.name: CheckinFiles

AddToSvn
Method.Implementation: Set cmd = $$$SVNINFO _ " --username " _ $username _ " --password " _ passwd _ " " _ fullPath Set stat = $ZF(-1, cmd) Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("AddToSvn: " _ fullPath _ " svn info:" _ stat) If stat '= 0 { Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile( $$$SVNINFO _" returned no information" ) Set cmd = $$$SVNADD _ " --username " _ $username _ " --password " _ passwd _ " " _ fullPath ; a non-recursive commit (-N) Set stat = $ZF(-1, cmd) Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("AddToSvn: svn add:" _ stat) if (commit) { Set cmd = $$$SVNCOMMIT _ " --username " _ $username _ " --password " _ passwd _ " -m ""Initialization"" " _ fullPath ; a non-recursive commit Set stat = $ZF(-1, cmd) Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("AddToSvn: svn commit:" _ stat) } } Quit stat

Method.name: UpdateInternalTimeForFiles
Method.Implementation: &sql(Declare C2 Cursor for Select InternalName Into :iName From ITFCOMMON.SrcCtrlInfo) set arrInd = 1 Set SQLCODE=0 &sql(OPEN C2) WHILE(SQLCODE = 0) { &sql(FETCH C2) Quit:SQLCODE Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile( "UpdateInternalTimeForFiles name:" _ iName) Set namesArr(arrInd) = iName set arrInd = arrInd + 1 } &sql(CLOSE C2) Set S1="" Do { Set S1=$Order(namesArr(S1)) Quit:S1="" ;get the next S1 subscript Do ..UpdateInternalTime(namesArr(S1)) } While S1'=""

Method.name: UpdateInternalTime
Method.Implementation: set intTime= ##class(%RoutineMgr).TS(iName) &sql(UPDATE ITFCOMMON.SrcCtrlInfo SET ClassModifiedTime=:intTime WHERE InternalName=:iName ) Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("UpdateInternalTime: " _ iName _ " " _ intTime)

Method.Implementation:
Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("setSources") kill ^|"ITFCOMMON"|ItfSourceCtrl set ^|"ITFCOMMON"|ItfSourceCtrl=$$$USRBASEDIR // set ^|"ITFCOMMON"|ItfSourceCtrl=$$$USRBASEDIR _ $username _ $$$SVNBASEDIR _ $$$SVNTRUNK set ^|"ITFCOMMON"|ItfSourceCtrl("CLS","*")="cls/" set ^|"ITFCOMMON"|ItfSourceCtrl("BPL","*")="bpl/" set sc=$$$OK
quit sc
